recognize_zh: 周邊血液抹片中有一顆小型成熟淋巴球，旁邊另一顆淋巴球的核被一條深而清楚的裂縫從中切開（cleaved lymphocyte），這種帶深裂痕的小淋巴球配合百日咳臨床，是 pertussis 淋巴球增多的典型表現。
features: Small mature lymphocyte with a deep, sharply defined nuclear cleft dividing the nucleus into two halves
Condensed, clumped mature chromatin without nucleoli
Scant cytoplasm, similar size to an adjacent normal small lymphocyte
Adjacent round small lymphocyte with dense chromatin for comparison
Unremarkable red cells and a few platelets in the background
describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows two small mature lymphocytes. One has a deep, cleanly incised nuclear cleft producing a bilobed, 'butt-like' appearance, with mature condensed chromatin, no nucleoli and scant cytoplasm. The accompanying lymphocyte is round and normal-appearing, and the red cells and platelets are unremarkable. In a child with paroxysmal cough and absolute lymphocytosis, findings are consistent with reactive lymphocytosis of Bordetella pertussis infection.

ddx.dx: Follicular lymphoma in leukemic phase (buttock cells)
ddx.vs: Leukemic FL shows a monotonous clonal population of cleaved cells in adults, with CD10+ light-chain-restricted B cells and BCL2 rearrangement, whereas pertussis lymphocytosis is polyclonal and predominantly T-cell in children.
Sézary cells have cerebriform, convoluted nuclei with multiple grooves rather than a single clean cleft and show CD4+ CD7-/CD26- clonal T cells.
ATLL cells are multilobated 'flower cells' with several petal-like lobes, whereas the cell here has a single deep cleft.
